profile.headline: Software Engineer I at USAA
profile.summary: IT Software developer specialized in Java and cloud oriented applications, always looking to learn new technologies that gives more efficiency and RoI to the final users.

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description: Working at client location as lead Java developer using technologies as docker, gradle, springboot for micro services development, as well as React and Redux for the ui development. Be responsible of coordinate India team efforts, maintaining an open communication channel between the two locations.

positions.title: Technical leader
positions.description:
Working at onsite client location at San Antonio, TX as part of agile development team. 
Implement talon SaaS components with new web applications as well as with classic applications. 
Active participant in management meetings and proposals to continuously improve company processes and work environment. 
Management of internal employees working as reporting manager for the company being in charge for more that 20+ developers both indian and mexican resources
Create dashboards in Service Now to monitor incidents and create statistics for resolution and participation of the resources assigned
Create Splunk queries and dashboards for monitoring application logs and possible critical errors 
Migration of multiple applications from WAS 7 to WAS 8.5
Successfully work in a multi cultural environment working with all shores (onshore, offshore and nearshore) development teams
L2 Support for USAA systems
Develop changes and code fixes for USAA customer relationship management systems based in java EE using websphere application servers using SCRUM methodology and actively participating in the different meetings assigned

positions.title: Team Lead of Azteca America systems
positions.locationName: Ciudad de México y alrededores, México
positions.description:
Successfully guide mettings with upper management business stakeholders in Azteca America, like Traffic Director, Sales director, CFOs and COOs meetings

Project management of azteca america's sales traffic and collections system

Led the team in charge of the development of the new traffic system for local stations called Pyramid obtaining awards and recognitions of the upper management for the quality of implementation

Mindset change in development team, encouraging  the transition from HTML4 based development to an HTML5 based.

Migration of java systems from Oracle Containers for java (OC4J) 10 to Red Hat Jboss enterprise application platform 6.4 (Jboss EAP)  with great results improving the stability of the apps.

Migration from Crystal Reports Servers V11 to Business Objects XI R3

Design and leading changes of interfaces between azteca america systems and 3rd party providers as Invision Inc (Dealmaker), Strata for sales force systems

Successful implementation of Pyramid traffic system at new local stations and/or affiliates.

Led the migration of current azteca america systems from a local server to a cloud based infrastructure running in a rackspace private cloud.

Pioneer of change  from traditional project management to management 3.0 implementing agile methodologies such as SCRUM

positions.title: Senior Java Javaee Consultant
positions.description:
Development and implementation of mobile webapps in Java for Psion teklogix mobile handelds for customs land operations
as EIR, previous checking and warehouse material check using HTML5, Advanced javascript and Oracle ADF framework
Development and implementation of RESTFul services with integration with Oracle forms software
Migration of Oracle forms project from 6i to 11g version
Setup and configuration of Oracle Weblogic servers

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Team Lead
positions.locationName: Ciudad de México y alrededores, México
positions.description:
Migration of Azteca America applications to newer server versions
Management between upper executives and the team to implement ATS system in San Francisco, New York, Miami and South west florida local stations 
Awarded recognition for the implementation of Product integration calendar and Digital customer reconciliation of product integration spots
Analysis and implementation of spots video authorization workflow
Management of development teams of up to 6 developers to execute projects for Azteca America
Led the development of a news web application for the Olympics of Beijing 2008 
Awarded with team leader role in 2008 for Azteca America IT division being in charge of traffic and sales systems (ATS, STS, NTS)
Implement interfaces between traffic systems and SAP to import billing, sales and collection info for executives reports
Developer for media local stations OPTVWEB
Developer for Ithic sales and traffic system for TV Azteca, the biggest IT development at that time
Developer for Azteca en Linea webservices and successfully migrated them from Java to .Net
